# Workshop manuals (text versions)

> Official eLearn workshop manuals for Alfa Romeo, Fiat and Lancia models. Each model has its own text version: plain HTML pages with the path, applicability and links of every topic. Pick the model, then follow its own llms.txt.

## Models
- [Alfa 147 (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-a147/en/llms.txt): 3900 topics, 5 engines
- [Alfa 159 (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/alfa/159/en/llms.txt): 4026 topics, 7 engines
- [Alfa Brera (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-aBrr/en/llms.txt): 3306 topics, 3 engines
- [Alfa GT (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-aGt/en/llms.txt): 3518 topics, 4 engines
- [Fiat Doblò (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fDbl/en/llms.txt): 4353 topics, 6 engines
- [Fiat Multipla (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fMltpl/en/llms.txt): 5111 topics, 2 engines
- [Fiat Panda (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fPnd/en/llms.txt): 3037 topics, 3 engines
- [Fiat Ulysse (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-fUlss/en/llms.txt): 3888 topics, 4 engines
- [Lancia Thesis (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lThss/en/llms.txt): 4944 topics, 6 engines
- [Lancia Ypsilon (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/llms.txt): 2606 topics, 4 engines
